title: acy project configuration (.acy.json)
description: Run settings for always-click-yes. The acy binary reads this file from the project root; explicit CLI flags override it. Unknown keys are an error — the binary refuses to run rather than silently ignore a typo.

model.description: Model alias or name for the claude session (e.g. "sonnet", "opus"). Unset = claude's default.

claudeBin.description: Path to the claude binary. Unset = "claude" from PATH.

countdown.description: Auto-approve delay per gated tool, as a Go duration string. Unset = "30s".

log.description: Debug log file (raw event stream, gate decisions, transitions). An explicit empty string disables logging. Unset = "acy-debug.log".

maxLines.description: Max lines shown per tool call/result/thinking block in the transcript. Unset = 10.

planTools.description: The built-in tools claude may use while planning. This is the registry, not an allowlist: anything left out cannot be called at all, which is what keeps the plan phase read-only.

useApiKey.description: Bill ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead of the claude.ai login. Unset = false: the key is stripped from claude's environment so a headless run can't silently bill the API account.

childModel.description: Model for dispatched children. Unset = sonnet.

taskBudget.description: Maximum USD for each dispatched child. Unset = $10; 0 explicitly permits an unlimited child.

runBudget.description: Maximum USD across all dispatched children. Unset = $50; 0 explicitly permits an unlimited run.
